$comment: Patterns use (?![\s\S]) for strict end-of-input; unlike $, this rejects a trailing line terminator.
title: Voice AI challenge submission v1
description: Private submission metadata, not credentials. The example file is an incomplete template, not a live target.

submission_id.description: Nonblank private identifier, stable across submission stages.

phone_e164.description: Actual assigned US toll-free NANP number in E.164 form. No default or dialable example is supplied.

reset_base_url.description: Registered HTTPS browser entry URL, with no userinfo, query, or fragment. The issuer appends a token fragment.

repository_url.description: HTTPS github.com repository root URL. Private repositories are allowed with reviewer access; no credentials, query, fragment, or subpaths.

commit_sha.description: Full commit SHA corresponding to the submitted deployment and setup document.

azure_architecture.description: Short Azure speech/LLM and ACS/Teams telephony architecture description.

setup_document.description: Forward-slash repo-relative path to a tracked setup file at commit_sha. No absolute paths, dot/dot-dot segments, drive prefixes, or external symlinks.

video_url.description: Private reviewer-accessible recorded walkthrough URL (or arranged accessible equivalent). May be null initially; required nonnull for walkthrough.

notes.description: Optional limitations and operational context; no keys, tokens, passwords, or raw logs.

httpsUrl.description: HTTPS URL without whitespace or userinfo. Consumers must also parse the URL, validate its authority, and verify access; a pattern is not a network/provenance check.
